text.tspan: Japan is an island country in East Asia,
and Kyushu. Tokyo, the capital, is one
of the world's most populous metros.
Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy by nominal GDP and third by purchasing power. A member of the G7, it excels in
automotive manufacturing, electronics, and robotics. The nation blends ancient traditions—from tea ceremonies to kabuki—with
cutting-edge technology and contemporary culture, creating a unique society where the past and future coexist harmoniously.
Note: Japan's population is notably homogeneous,
though immigration has increased in recent decades.

g.text: Iconic volcano, hot springs, UNESCO site
Sources: World Bank (GDP data), Statistics Bureau of Japan (population), Japan National Tourism Organization (attractions)
